# AWS Codebase Documentor

Analyzes codebases and generates structured technical documentation with source-of-truth citations and architecture views, optimized for AWS workloads built with CDK, CloudFormation, and Terraform.

## Agent

This is an **agent plugin**: every skill, command, hook, and MCP server below is bound to the [`aws-codebase-documentor`](./agents/aws-codebase-documentor.md) agent, which the host runtime spawns as a dynamic sub-agent.

- Claude Code: `@agent-aws-codebase-documentor:aws-codebase-documentor` or let Claude delegate based on the agent description
- Headless: `claude --agent aws-codebase-documentor:aws-codebase-documentor`

## Skills

| Skill | What it does |
|---|---|
| `document-service` | This skill should be used when the user asks to "analyze this codebase", "document this service", "generate technical docs", "I inherited this code", "help me understand this system", "create docs for this project", "wh… |

## MCP servers

Declared in [`.mcp.json`](./.mcp.json) and bound to the agent through its `tools:` allowlist.

| Server | Transport | Launch | Agent tool pattern | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `awsknowledge` | http | `https://knowledge-mcp.global.api.aws` | `mcp__plugin_aws-codebase-documentor_awsknowledge__*` |  |
| `awsiac` | stdio | `uvx awslabs.aws-iac-mcp-server@latest` | `mcp__plugin_aws-codebase-documentor_awsiac__*` |  |

AWS credentials are inherited from the host environment (`AWS_PROFILE`, SSO, or instance role). `AWS_REGION` defaults to `us-east-1` when unset. Toggle any server off per project in `/mcp`.
